reason: A rescue console for diagnosing failed DeepSeek Harness plugin loading and temporarily disabling or restoring affected plugins through controlled local profile configuration updates.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 插件加载失败时诊断问题，并临时跳过或恢复相关插件的本地救援控制台。
summaries.en: A local rescue console for diagnosing failed DeepSeek Harness plugin loads and temporarily skipping or restoring affected plugins.

capabilities: Diagnoses failed plugin loading from displayed errors
Temporarily disables selected plugins by editing the local DSH profile configuration
Restores plugin entries previously disabled by Boot Guard
Provides local read-only preview, health checks, and diagnostic copying
